text: This is the veil.
Stand at its edge and look in.
It does not look like a wall.
It looks like weather.
A slow, gray, forgetting, rolling toward you.
Soft as sleep.
There's nothing violent about it.
That is what makes it so complete.
It does not take your memories by force.
It simply stops reminding you.
Watch what happens as it reaches you.
Your name, the true one,
the one the council called you by,
dissolves first.
Like breath off a mirror.
Then the unity,
the feeling of being everyone at once,
thins into being only yourself,
sealed inside one small skull.
Then the mission itself,
the reason you came, sinks below the surface like a stone in deep water.
You will spend decades feeling for it
with your toes and never touching bottom.
Here is the part no one warns you about.
You consented to this.
Somewhere above the weather,
the part of you that is still awake
is watching this happen and loving you through it.
The forgetting is not a punishment.
It is the price of admission to a world
where choices must be made in the dark
to count as choices.
Step forward.
The veil is already closing behind you.
You will not remember this conversation.
But some night, years from now,
you will wake with tears on your face
and no idea why.
And that will be me reminding you.
